reason: The plugin is primarily a DeepSeek Harness session-management utility that gives users a UI menu item and slash command to delete conversations, then performs a queued, two-phase cleanup that hides sessions and archives logs to a recoverable trash directory on startup.

summaries.zh: DSH-DELETE 是 DeepSeek Harness 会话管理插件，提供会话列表删除入口与 /delete-conversation 命令，在确认后提交删除请求，并在后续启动时将会话日志移入可恢复的回收区。
summaries.en: DSH-DELETE is a DeepSeek Harness session-management plugin that adds a session delete menu action and /delete-conversation command, queues deletion requests after confirmation, and archives conversation logs to a recoverable trash area during startup.

capabilities: Queue and process conversation deletion requests
Add a session-row deletion action in the workspace UI
Hide sessions immediately after deletion confirmation
Move conversation log directories to a configurable trash location during startup recovery
Require explicit confirmation token before writing deletion actions
